sources.title: promptfrisk · PyPI
sources.snippet: frisk is built on Laya, the System 1 decision model from Nandha Kishor M (@NandhaKishorM) at Convai Innovations, released under Apache-2.0. The guardrail and the question design are the part frisk adds on top, that too ported to three languages.

sources.title: Laya AI Model: How It Works, Run It Locally, and Evaluate It
sources.snippet: The Laya AI model is built for a particular kind of work: making a bounded decision about an input, then returning a structured answer and probabilities. Give it a support ticket, an email, a conversation, or a JSON state. Ask which queue should receive it, how urgent it is, or whether a stated condition is true. Laya answers those questions without writing a paragraph that your application ...

sources.title: Laya AI — Calibrated decisions in one forward pass
sources.snippet: Define questions and options at request time; Laya AI scores them in one pass and returns calibrated probabilities you can gate, log, reproduce, and audit. The English root uses ModernBERT-large (421M parameters, 512-token context). The multilingual model uses mmBERT-base (322M parameters, 100+ languages).
